c74object.name: evi.gaussiannoise~
c74object.description:
evi.gaussiannoise~ is a 'max define' for the evi_gaussiannoise.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.gaussiannoise~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does.
An approximate 'Box-Muller' gaussian noise distribution. It looks roughly the same as white noise in a spectral view, slightly different in a scope~. In a histogram one can see the distribution. The point is the gaussian random number distribution (see the helpfile for details).
c74object.discussion: Note that in a normal distribution the gaussian outlet (outlet 1) should give output in the range approximately -HALFPI..HALFPI. However, because of the approximations used here, the given output is approximately in the range -1.11..1.11. In the evi_approx.genexpr source file this is NOT accounted for, but in this evi_gaussiannoise.gendsp / evi.gaussiannoise~ abstraction it is accounted for so that, like the other outputs, gaussian noise outputs in range -1..1
